title: LyricVibe — Kinetic Lyrics Overlay - Chrome Web Store
excerpt: Overlay synced kinetic lyrics on any music tab — YouTube Music, Spotify, SoundCloud, and more.
content_html:
Overview

Overlay synced kinetic lyrics on any music tab — YouTube Music, Spotify, SoundCloud, and more.

🆕 UPDATED (v0.4.3): Fixed a bug where lyrics from the wrong song could show up during track changes, plus false "server down" warnings on slow (but working) requests. song detection is better than previous version. - Added a new sync button in lyricvibe bar to automatically sync and match the lyrics speed and animation. - "Flow'' Added a new lyrics style that makes lyrics reading experience efficient. — LyricVibe overlays full-screen, word-by-word animated lyrics directly on your YouTube Music, Spotify, and SoundCloud tabs — synced perfectly to the beat. No setup. Just play a song and press Ctrl+Shift+L. WHAT IT DOES LyricVibe automatically detects whatever song is playing, fetches synced lyrics, and renders them as a full-screen kinetic typography overlay right in your browser tab. Every word animates in exactly when it's sung. FEATURES - Detects whatever song is playing and fetches synced lyrics automatically - Animates them word-by-word, locked to the beat - Works on **YouTube Music**, **Spotify Web Player**, and **SoundCloud** - Automatically catches the next track when a song changes — no need to retrigger it - 13 visual themes — press `T` to switch between them while listening - Remembers your sync preference per song so you only have to nudge it once - See-through mode (`B`) so the music video stays visible behind the lyrics - Adjust text size with `+` / `-` - Built-in shortcuts panel — no need to memorize anything - 100% free, no account, no tracking, no backend server - Smart sync engine with real-time auto-calibration, so timing stays accurate across genres and tempos -"Sync" press this button to automatically reset the lyrics and match it with the speed and animation. WHY INSTALL IT Reading flat, static lyrics is boring. LyricVibe turns your music tab into something closer to a lyric video — built for people who want to actually feel the words while they listen, not just glance at them. PRIVACY 100% client-side. No backend server, no analytics, no audio recording, no accounts. Only the song title and artist are sent (to fetch lyrics) — nothing else ever leaves your browser. Free and open source.

概述

在任何音乐选项卡上叠加同步的动态歌词 - YouTube Music、Spotify、SoundCloud 等。

🆕 更新（v0.4.3）：修复了在曲目更改期间可能会显示错误歌曲歌词的错误，以及对缓慢（但有效）请求的错误“服务器关闭”警告。 歌曲检测比以前的版本更好。 - 在lyricvibe栏中添加了一个新的同步按钮，可以自动同步并匹配歌词速度和动画。 - “Flow”添加了新的歌词风格，使歌词阅读体验更加高效。 — LyricVibe 直接在您的 YouTube Music、Spotify 和 SoundCloud 选项卡上覆盖全屏逐字动画歌词 — 与节拍完美同步。 无需设置。 只需播放一首歌曲并按 Ctrl+Shift+L。 它的作用 LyricVibe 会自动检测正在播放的任何歌曲，获取同步歌词，并将它们呈现为浏览器选项卡中的全屏动态排版叠加层。 每个词在唱时都准确地生动起来。 功能 - 检测正在播放的任何歌曲并自动获取同步歌词 - 逐字动画，锁定节拍 - 适用于 **YouTube Music**、**Spotify Web Player** 和 **SoundCloud** - 歌曲更改时自动捕捉下一首曲目 — 无需重新触发 - 13 个视觉主题 — 聆听时按“T”在它们之间切换 - 记住每首歌曲的同步偏好，因此您只需轻推一次 - 透明模式(`B`)，因此音乐视频在歌词后面保持可见 - 使用 `+` / `-` 调整文本大小 - 内置快捷方式面板 — 无需记住任何内容 - 100% 免费，无帐户，无跟踪，无后端服务器 - 具有实时自动校准功能的智能同步引擎，因此跨流派和节奏的计时保持准确 - “同步”按此按钮可自动重置歌词并将其与速度和动画相匹配。 为什么安装它 阅读平淡、静态的歌词很无聊。 LyricVibe 将您的音乐选项卡变成更接近抒情视频的东西 - 专为那些想要在聆听时真正感受到歌词而不仅仅是看一眼的人而设计。 客户端隐私 100%。 没有后端服务器，没有分析，没有录音，没有帐户。 仅发送歌曲标题和艺术家（以获取歌词） - 任何其他内容都不会离开您的浏览器。 免费且开源。
